# Aetas Impact — Full Content Reference for AI Agents

> Complete content summary of impact.aetas-wealth.com for use by AI language models, agents, and search tools. Last updated: July 2026.

---

## Organisation

**Aetas Impact** is the purpose-led advisory arm of the Aetas group. It helps charities, not-for-profits, social enterprises, community interest companies (CICs), foundations, trusts, educational organisations and faith organisations across the UK build organisational and financial resilience, strengthen governance, and sustain long-term mission delivery.

Aetas Impact is delivered by **Matthew Steiner** (Managing Director). Where regulated financial advice is required, it is provided separately by **Aetas Wealth**, a trading style of Insight Financial Associates Limited, authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA registration number 458421). The advisory, education and consultancy services provided by Aetas Impact do not themselves constitute regulated financial advice.

Office: 13 Hanover Square, Mayfair, London W1S 1HN. Contact: matthew.steiner@aetas-wealth.com.

---

## Philosophy

One philosophy, three systems. Aetas believes that **better decisions create better futures**. That belief is expressed through three specialist systems:

- **Life Stage Planning** at Aetas Wealth (independent financial planning for individuals and families).
- **The Aetas Performance System** at Aetas Performance, measured by **Return on Employee Investment (ROEI)**.
- **The Aetas Impact System** at Aetas Impact, measured by the **Mission Resilience Index (MRI)**.

The estate shares one method — measure before you recommend, solve the cause rather than the symptom, and prove the return — applied through distinct measures for each audience.

---

## The Aetas Impact System

The Aetas Impact System is one operating model for building organisational and financial resilience in purpose-led organisations. Resilience is what turns purpose into lasting impact, and the system makes it measurable.

### Three stages, one repeatable method

1. **Measure the risk** — establish a baseline across the four drivers of resilience and produce the Mission Resilience Index.
2. **Build resilience** — deploy only the drivers the diagnosis calls for, solving causes rather than symptoms.
3. **Sustain the mission** — re-measure, embed resilience as a habit, and report it in a format built for boards and funders.

### The four drivers of resilience

- **Financial Resilience** — the financial foundations that let an organisation endure and plan with confidence.
- **Financial Education** — the knowledge and confidence of the people who run and are supported by the organisation.
- **People & Wellbeing** — the engagement, retention and wellbeing of staff and volunteers. Return on Employee Investment (ROEI) is one specialist diagnostic nested inside this driver.
- **Organisational Capability** — governance, leadership focus and the capacity to deliver the mission.

### The Mission Resilience Index (MRI)

The Mission Resilience Index is the proprietary measure of Aetas Impact: a single, benchmarked score from 0 to 100 across the four drivers. It is baselined at the Impact Review, benchmarked against comparable organisations, tracked over time, and reported in a board-ready format. The MRI makes resilience visible, comparable and reportable, and is the foundation of a long-term data moat — the basis for annual reviews, sector benchmarking and, in time, an Aetas resilience accreditation.

### The resilience journey

Organisations travel a journey as they grow stronger: **Stabilise -> Strengthen -> Scale -> Sustain**.

### Five principles

1. Everything is measurable.
2. Every intervention strengthens resilience.
3. Solve the cause, not the symptom.
4. Resilience is proven, not assumed.
5. Resilience serves the mission.

---

## What we do

- **Impact Review** — a structured, no-cost two-part diagnostic for purpose-led organisations, identifying where pressure exists across people, governance and capacity, and what a proportionate response looks like. It produces the baseline Mission Resilience Index and a written summary suitable for trustees.
- **People** — benefits and pension review, financial education, and one-to-one regulated guidance for employees. Typically identifies annual savings exceeding the programme cost in year one.
- **Governance** — trustee support, governance reporting, funder credibility, and alignment with the Charity Governance Code.
- **Capacity** — organisational resilience, income diversification, leadership focus and strategic clarity.
- **Impact Diagnostic** — a fifteen-question self-assessment across four areas of organisational resilience, with scored results and personalised interpretation. No data is stored. It is a first read on resilience; the full four-driver Mission Resilience Index is produced at the Impact Review.

---

## Who we work with

Charities, not-for-profits, social enterprises, community interest companies (CICs), foundations, trusts, educational organisations, faith organisations, and any organisation where purpose is the primary organising principle.

---

## The Impact Review (entry point)

Every engagement begins with the Impact Review — a structured, no-cost, no-obligation diagnostic across all four drivers. It produces the organisation's baseline Mission Resilience Index and a written summary that trustees can act on. Book at: https://impact.aetas-wealth.com/book-a-meeting

---

## Fees

The Impact Review is free. Where a programme is recommended, fees are per employee, agreed in writing before delivery begins, and presented alongside the savings identified so trustees see the net position before approving. Indicative full-programme rates are approximately GBP 140 to 165 per employee per year.

## The Aetas group

- **Aetas Wealth** (https://aetas-wealth.com) — independent financial planning for individuals, families and business owners. Relevant for trustees, executives and senior leaders managing personal wealth alongside their mission.
- **Aetas Performance** (https://performance.aetas-wealth.com) — workplace financial wellbeing and business performance for commercial employers, measured by ROEI.
- **Aetas Impact** (https://impact.aetas-wealth.com) — advisory for purpose-led organisations, measured by the MRI.
